title.en: Find the way without seeing the sign
title.sr: Nađi put bez gledanja u znak

aim.en: You can design building interiors, vertical links, accessible toilets, and tactile/acoustic orientation that guides users without relying on visual text boards (ISO 21542).
aim.sr: Umeš da projektuješ unutrašnjost objekta, vertikalne veze, pristupačne toalete i taktilno/akustičko vođenje koje vodi korisnike bez oslanjanja na vizuelne table (ISO 21542).

bring.en: Building floor plans at 1:100, door and sanitary schedules, tracing overlay.
bring.sr: Osnove objekta 1:100, šeme vrata i sanitarnih čvorova, paus folija.

text.en: Wayfinding relies on materials, acoustic reverberation, tactile flooring, lighting contrasts, and air circulation. We detail entrance lobbies, accessible sanitary cabins (min 150 × 150 cm clear turning zone), and stair/lift cores.
text.sr: Orijentacija u prostoru oslanja se na materijale, akustiku, taktilne površine, kontraste osvetljenja i strujanje vazduha. Detaljno rešavamo ulazni hol, pristupačnu sanitarnu kabinu (krug okretanja 150 cm) i stepenišno-liftovsko jezgro.

text.en: Verify that every doorway on the primary circulation route provides at least 80 cm (preferably 90 cm) clear passage without threshold snags.
text.sr: Potvrditi da svaki otvor na primarnoj komunikaciji nudi najmanje 80 cm (preporučeno 90 cm) čiste širine bez zapinjanja o prag.
